user.title: Add a window
user.description: Link the window to a shutter, a temperature sensor and the azimuth interval during which it receives direct sun.

data.sill_height: Bottom of the window above the floor
data.sun_depth: Allowed sunlight depth on the floor

data_description.presence_entities: The house is considered occupied when at least one selected entity is home. Select every household member.
data_description.azimuth_start: Use 0° for north, 90° for east, 180° for south and 270° for west.
data_description.azimuth_end: Ranges crossing north are supported, for example 300° to 40°.
data_description.progressive_enabled: Requires a top-down shutter supporting percentage positions and the four measurements below. Adjustments use 10-point steps, at least 30 minutes apart.
data_description.facade_azimuth: Direction perpendicular to the glass, facing outside: north 0°, east 90°, south 180°, west 270°.
data_description.window_height: Uncovered height when the shutter is fully open, in metres.
data_description.sill_height: Vertical distance from the floor to the bottom of the glazed opening, in metres; 0 for floor-level windows.
data_description.sun_depth: Maximum sunlight penetration across the floor, perpendicular to the facade, in metres. This distance decreases as the room heats up.

behavior.title: Shared behavior
behavior.description: These settings apply to every window. They are requested only once and remain available as controls on the Solar Shutters device.

data.dawn_dusk_away: Open at dawn and close at dusk when away

data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional temperature sensor or weather entity. Anticipates outdoor heat in progressive mode. Clear this field to disable anticipation for all windows.

abort.already_configured: This shutter is already assigned to a window.

error.geometry_required: This measurement is required in progressive mode.
error.invalid_geometry: Enter valid geometry: positive height and depth, nonnegative sill height, azimuth from 0 to 360°.
